# Legacy save fixtures

These fixtures intentionally retain pre-refactor script paths without UID references. Do not rewrite their paths when reorganizing current code.

- `legacy_weapon_match.tres` was generated by `weapon_save_regression` in the unchanged baseline before the folder moves. It covers multiple weapon definitions, typed loadouts, and an embedded custom weapon.
- `legacy_casualty_unit.tres` was generated by `casualty_persistence_regression` in that baseline. It retains a casualty record and equipment state.
- `legacy_soldier.tres` was authored to exercise the former `soldier_save_data.gd` path, identity, weapon state, and combat values.

`save_path_compatibility_regression` loads these files through the compatibility scripts at the old paths and checks their values and resource types. It also saves and reloads the legacy match.
